about: Staff talking to staff inside a chat, and the small lines labels and priority leave. A note is private, short, written by a person at the counter; the assistant's hand-over note is in assistant.json. Writers: any person who handles chats, unless 'by' narrows it; a writer in an advisor file uses their own notes first.

labels.tires_instead: when the job block is new_tires, flat, alignment, balance, rotation or tpms, 'tires' replaces 'price' or 'booking'
labels.when: added by the person who handles the chat, after their reply and before they resolve it; a symptom chat is labelled booking only when a time was set; the advisor's label_share in the sheet decides whether it happens
labels.handoff: the product adds 'handoff' with the hand-over and a person's reply takes it off; the bank never adds or removes it by hand

patterns.when: a person sets it when they first read a complaint
a company vehicle off the road; the page says it is looked at ahead of the line
the customer has asked twice and the car is past its promised time
a car stopped on the road, overheating, or a work van with a driver waiting
the customer said they will come next month, or is comparing shops and asked for nothing more
a person sets it back once the chat is answered and the matter is handled

priority.by_wait: everything else moves by the wait, as the product computes it; the bank writes no line for that
